title: Allocate requested seats with deterministic fallback
statement: There are limit seats numbered 1..limit. For each row, reject passengers who already have an assigned seat. Otherwise assign preferred if it is in range and free; if unavailable/invalid, assign the lowest free seat. Reject if all are occupied. Rejected rows do not reserve passenger IDs. Return assigned/rejected counts and sum of (passenger+1)*seat across accepted rows.
constraints: passenger is nonnegative; preferred may be negative or out of range; repeated passengers allowed.
Use the exact declared Entry and Report record fields and solve signature. Return all three Report fields; do not mutate the caller's records.
All arithmetic fits signed int64; there are at most 30 records. limit is in [0, 30]. Return fresh results; no I/O, tests, exceptions, panic, or static-check bypasses.

jett.signature:
namespace benchmark

struct Entry:
    passenger: int64
    preferred: int64

struct Report:
    assigned: int64
    rejected: int64
    seat_checksum: int64

function solve(view rows: list[Entry], limit: int64) returns Report
